verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 102.1 (+2.4% in a day) and momentum is 41: prices are falling. 84s cost 700, 85s 2,200 and 86s 1,100. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-12T23:18:00+01:00}}.

moves.title: Buy Myles Lewis-Skelly 88 Future Stars after its 14% fall, sell in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 689,000 coins. Now 727,000. Buy the dip: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often recovers part of the fall within two days. Picked because it is down 13.8% in about a day. This is the strategy's first tracked call. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Sell Anis Hadj Moussa 80 Team of the week after its 41% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 19,750 coins. Now 18,500. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 41.1% in about a day. This is the strategy's first tracked call. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Quiet midweek: plan your weekend squad now
moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-10-15T07:59:00+01:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 86s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,200 (1.05 coins per Item Score point), 86s 1,100 (0.27 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,600 (1.20 coins per Item Score point), 88s 10,750 (1.30 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 86s then 84s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Ayden Heaven and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Ayden Heaven 75 Rare -36.2%; Jérémy Jacquet 77 Rare -27.4%; Gonzalo 75 Rare -26.4%; Zinedine Zidane 94 Base Icon -26.0%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: 5x 80+ Upgrade SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 7.7K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
